scope: Native architecture classification: authored dispositions, IR provenance and atomic persistence
evidence: Mixed promotion/association/context decisions preserve actor, source contract, adopted revisions, one Spec version bump and immutable history/outbox; existing normative IR is unchanged and no workflow transition is performed.
Accepted event suggestion retains event schema, string error contract and versioned external reference, without inventing HTTP fields. Invalid last IR rolls back the whole batch.
Local association creates no new IR and grants no delivery evidence. Foreign IR association is rejected with unchanged persistence.

Publication-only promotion retains consumption and error policy as explicit contextual remainder; original source remains intact and resulting delivery inventory contains only the authored local IR obligation.

Permission denial occurs before design-body reads and every write. Exact replay is read-only and actor-bound; current authority still applies. Changed intent/key reuse conflicts; concurrent identical requests share one receipt/version bump.
A candidate appearing after an earlier batch remains pending. Decisions for the same source are local to each Spec and may differ without contamination.
Injected history, outbox or decision-storage failures and outer rollback leave no orphan IR/key/decision; exact retry after failure succeeds.

Frontend requires explicit choices and type, accepts suggestions only on request, supports selected contract parts/local IR association, and preserves exact unknown-outcome retries without double submit.

tests.reused_witness_campaign: native-architecture-read-community1.xml: 31 passed on same unchanged main86; specific acceptance witnesses inspected and reused, not counted again as new tests

limits: Internal ActorContext permission capabilities are distinct from the removed persisted Agent.permissions contract, as recorded in C1/C3. Only misleading legacy naming was corrected; authority behavior was not changed.
Fixtures seed lifecycle/source facts where stated; these tests do not qualify the complete Spec start transition or installed end-to-end authentication.
No product/SPA change; main86 proof and closure remain applicable with eight zero budgets.
No conversion, migration, promotion or real-data mutation.
